title: Speaking up by itself
text: Speaking up by itself (Features → "Von selbst melden", off by default; profiles only): once released it is on from the start for every profile; in the "Me" window under "Proactive" each profile sets why the assistant speaks unasked, each kind on its own, or switches it off entirely: appointments ahead ("In 20 minutes: dentist. Shall I remind you again at 9:55?", a "yes" sets the reminder), its own smart home rules ("Whirlpool above 37.5", "bathroom window is open and rain is on", "washing machine power below 5 for 3 minutes"; read only, never switching), a short greeting with the next appointment or reminder when the conversation is opened after three hours or more, at most one follow-up a day on a plan mentioned yesterday, new mail from chosen senders (sender and subject only) and a weather note for tomorrow via web search. Plus quiet hours, a daily limit and learning from feedback: "nicht jetzt" means two hours of quiet, "das interessiert mich nicht" halves how often that kind may speak (can be reset). The panel decides when, by fixed rules from real data; where the model words something (follow-up, weather), its answer only counts when it quotes the data. With the conversation o

head: Voice chat
title: Speaking up by itself
text: pen the note is spoken, otherwise it arrives as a push notification. Since V01.0.179 only the first device of the profile says it (page or iPhone app), the others stay silent, just like reminders (V01.0.176). Every note is in the log with its reason. Since V01.0.385 the follow-up is a fixed sentence with the person's own words ("Gestern hast du zu mir gesagt: „…“. Hat das geklappt?"); the model only points at a sentence, and the panel takes it only when it is an own plan in the first person (no question, no request to the assistant, no pasted text, no question about a mail or web page, nothing from briefing, jobs or meetings). Asked about a note ("what do you mean?", "where is that from?"), the model gets its basis from the panel and must not make up another source; for mail notes only "sender and subject read", never mail text. Logs → Requests show it as "von selbst: Grundlage", Live shows a refused pick as an event.

head: Voice chat
title: Home Assistant tells the Spark
text: Home Assistant tells the Spark (since V01.0.314, plan plaene/home-assistant-meldungen.md): the smart home rules under "Proactive" can do more. Each rule can speak *at most every N minutes* (e.g. a motion sensor at most every 10 minutes), for "changes" *on*, *off* or both, and have an extra condition: *only when I am away* (the person in Home Assistant with your profile name or the one chosen under "Me in Home Assistant"), *only when nobody is home*, *only at night* or *only during the day* (by sun.sun, else 9 pm to 6 am). Plus five parts, each with its own admin switch under Features → Speaking up by itself, all off at first, never for guests. Once released they work for every profile; what speaks up by itself is on from the start and can be switched off one by one under Me → Proactive: *Instant notes from Home Assistant*: the Spark keeps a WebSocket connection to your Home Assistant (the same address and token, only the devices of your rules, subscribe_entities); a change arrives in about a second, also a motion sensor that triggers only briefly. If the connection drops, the Spark checks every minute again. *House notes on speakers*: a rule also says its own sentence on chosen spe

head: Voice chat
title: Home Assistant tells the Spark
text: akers that take announcements from you, e.g. "Someone rang the bell."; only its own sentence without names, never for person devices and never with a camera picture, not in the speaker's quiet hours, at most 20 an hour. *Home Assistant tells the Spark*: a list of event names with a fixed sentence (e.g. klingel → "Es hat geklingelt.") and a key of its own; Home Assistant calls rest_command.spark_melden with event: klingel (POST /api/ha/event). Only names from the list count, nothing else from the request is read or said; at most 30 a minute, a pause per event (default 1 minute). *Smart home rule by voice*: "Sag mir Bescheid, wenn jemand an der Haustür ist", "Melde dich, wenn Anna heimkommt": the panel recognizes the sentence by fixed words, finds the device and asks "Soll ich mich melden, wenn …?"; only a "yes" in the same conversation adds the rule. *Describe a camera picture*: a rule can name a camera from Home Assistant; when it applies, the local language model describes the still in a few words. The picture is never stored, the description is outside text and goes to your devices only, at most 30 an hour. Log lines start with "hamelden:". Status → Live shows the live connection

head: Voice chat
title: Home Assistant tells the Spark
text: (under channels) and each note, event and described camera picture in fixed words, without device names, sentences or camera words. You don't have to type devices for a rule (since V01.0.317): the field suggests all devices from Home Assistant, "Zuletzt geändert" shows the last changed ones, and with "Gerät erkennen" you trigger the sensor within 40 seconds (motion, door, bell); whatever changes shows up to tap. The panel only compares the change time Home Assistant reports itself. Rules can be edited (since V01.0.319): "Edit" brings a rule back into the form, "Check and save" checks it like a new one and replaces it in the same place; it then starts fresh (speaks only after it was false once). Since V01.0.334 each fired rule and event shows on Status → Live as a request of "Home Assistant" (rule or event) with camera picture, note (Web Push, Apple Push, Android app, Telegram or the open page) and speaker announcement; everything else the Spark says by itself as a request of "Von selbst" (e.g. greeting, reminder, task). Never the sentence.

head: Voice chat
title: Natural turn-taking
text: Natural turn-taking (on by default, conversation settings): during a short pause the recording is transcribed already. A finished sentence ends the turn at once and its transcript becomes the question, so the answer starts noticeably sooner; after "and …", "because …", "um" or a comma the assistant waits up to 2 s for you to go on.

head: Voice chat
title: New conversation every day
text: New conversation every day (on by default, conversation settings → Display): the first question of a new day starts a new conversation; earlier ones stay in the history and can be picked and continued.

head: Voice chat
title: Speaker identification
text: Speaker identification (off by default, Features): each profile reads three short sentences in the "Me" window. When the assistant then clearly recognizes a voice, it answers for that profile, with its memory, documents, reminders and voice, even on a guest device. The conversation shows "🎙 name" below the question. When someone other than the logged-in profile speaks at a device, the assistant gets only that one question (not the device's conversation), and the exchange stays out of the logged-in profile's history and memory. When the voice is unclear, nothing changes. Recognition runs on the Spark's CPU (Resemblyzer model, Apache 2.0) and needs no GPU memory. Strictness is adjustable. A voice is not a password: someone who sounds very similar or plays a recording can get into a profile.

head: Voice chat
title: Profiles and memory
text: Profiles and memory: under People and devices the admin creates profiles with a name and PIN. In the chat you log in with the "Guest" button at the top of the conversation by typing name and PIN. Logged in, the assistant remembers things for good when you tell it to ("remember that I'm vegetarian") or when they will be useful later, and forgets them on request; the Me lists what it knows, for deleting. Memory and conversations belong to the profile and live on the Spark, so the same history shows on every device you are logged in on: which profile is asking is decided only by the login (cookie) or the device key, never by the model, and guests get no memory. Speakers and your own programs get a device key under People and devices that belongs to one profile, and send it as the header X-Speech-Device to /api/chat. A new PIN logs out every browser of that profile; deleting a profile removes its memory and devices. The data lives on the Spark under /var/lib/speech-spark/users, one folder per profile.

head: Voice chat
title: Home Assistant
text: Home Assistant (Funktionen → "Home Assistant", off by default): each profile connects its own Home Assistant in the "Me" window under "Smart home" with the address (e.g. http://homeassistant.local:8123) and a long-lived access token (Home Assistant: your profile → Security; best for a separate non-admin user). Then "turn on the living room light" or "how warm is it in the bathroom?" work in the conversation. Commands go to Home Assistant's own Assist (/api/conversation/process), so only entities exposed to Assist (Settings → Voice assistants → Expose) can be switched. Devices Assist does not know are switched directly through their service (e.g. switch.turn_on), except locks, alarm systems and updates. With a code word ("Me" window → Smart home) the assistant switches only when the code word is in the same message ("lights off, code word sunflower"); without it, it asks. The panel checks this itself, not the language model; the model and the stored conversations see only "[Codewort]", it is stored encrypted and compared with some tolerance for speech recognition (a letter or two off, "Apollo 13" = "Apollo dreizehn"). Questions need no code word. Also (ideas from ha-mcp): history ("

head: Voice chat
title: Home Assistant
text: how warm was it in the bathroom yesterday?"), several devices at once ("all lights in the living room off", each checked; an unknown room never switches the whole home), typo-tolerant device search and to-do lists such as the shopping list (read, add, tick off; changes need the code word). Questions about values, states, zones and where someone is are read directly (/api/states) instead: the assistant sees every device, sensor, zone and person the token's user may see, exposed or not. Home Assistant tells rooms (areas) only to an admin token; without admin rights devices are found by their names only. Only that profile can use its Home Assistant: guests never, and a voice recognized by speaker identification at someone else's device neither. The token is checked before saving, stays on the Spark (users/<id>/homeassistant.json, mode 0600) and is never sent back to the browser. When several devices fit a switching command, the device whose name, room or device class fits wins over one that only fits by its kind ("TV in the living room" is the TV there, not the Apple TV box next to it). If it stays unclear, the Spark switches nothing and names the fitting devices; the model then gets

head: Voice chat
title: Home Assistant
text: no switching tool (since V01.0.461).

head: Voice chat
title: Ask instead of guessing
text: Ask instead of guessing (Funktionen → "Rückfrage statt Raten", off by default; released for every profile): when several devices fit a switching command, the Spark switches nothing at random but asks: "Several fit: Samsung, Samsung The Frame or TV. Which one do you mean?". In the chat the devices are buttons below it, plus "None of these". When it cannot find the device exactly it asks "I can't find that exactly. Do you mean …?"; "None of these" or "show all" brings the whole device list with a search field, grouped by room (never locks, alarm panels or remotes). The answer may be typed, spoken or tapped: name, room or number ("the second"). It only counts in the same conversation, on the same device and for two minutes; the code word of the command covers the choice but is never stored or spoken. When the Spark itself picked one of several devices, "No, the Apple TV" corrects it: the wrongly switched device goes back to its old state, the right one is switched. Fixed rules in the panel decide, never the language model. (since V01.0.470)

head: Voice chat
title: Remember the choice
text: Remember the choice (sub-switch, off by default): after a choice or a correction the Spark asks "Shall I remember that "TV in the living room" is Samsung?" (buttons "Yes, remember" and "No"). Only a yes stores it. From then on the same sentence switches that device at once; the code word is still needed. All mappings are under Me → Memory → "Mappings": change words, other target, delete, or assign your own from the device list with "Give own names". They live in the profile's zuordnungen.json and go with the memory into your own storage and the backup. The live page shows numbers only (open questions, asked today, chosen, corrected, remembered, used), the log fixed words only ("klaeren: frage ha 3 kandidaten"), never devices or sentences. (since V01.0.470)

head: Voice chat
title: Asking back for bus and train, weather and messages too
text: Asking back for bus and train, weather and messages too (same switch): "to the station" fits several stops and names none exactly, so the Spark asks with buttons instead of taking the first; the same for place names in different regions ("Karlsbad" in Germany and Czechia) in the weather and for lists in Home Assistant ("Einkauf" fits "Einkaufsliste" and "Einkauf Baumarkt"; for a change the code word of the request covers the choice). The choice runs the same request with the chosen target; after a yes the word stands for it from then on (Me → Mappings, areas "Bus and train", "Places (weather)" and "Lists"). With "Do you mean Quirin Meier or Quirin Müller?" the names are buttons below. In Telegram the choices come as a keyboard under the answer; a tap sends the name like a typed answer. In the apps and at a speaker the spoken or typed answer does it (name, room or number). A calendar named for an appointment that does not exist is never silently replaced by the first one any more: the Spark enters nothing and names the calendars there are. (since V01.0.470)

head: Voice chat
title: Searching conversations
text: Searching conversations: the magnifier next to the conversation list (on phones in the menu) searches all earlier conversations, a profile's with a profile, the browser's as a guest. A click opens the conversation at that spot.

head: Voice chat
title: Earlier conversations
text: Earlier conversations (Funktionen → "Frühere Gespräche", on by default; profiles only): the assistant can look up what you talked about before ("what did you tell me about the grill last week?", "what did we talk about yesterday?"), searching only your own profile's saved conversations. Conversations that have been quiet for ten minutes are also read once in the background, while nobody is talking, and up to three lasting facts per conversation go into the profile's memory, marked "automatic" in the "Me" window, where they can be deleted. Each profile can switch this learning off in the conversation settings ("Learn from conversations"). Once a week (or with "Propose cleanup") the assistant proposes merging duplicate entries and removing outdated ones; nothing changes until you accept the proposal under Me → Memory. With notifications on, a note is sent.

head: Voice chat
title: Pronunciation
text: Pronunciation: Settings → Speech output → Pronunciation takes one rule per line, e.g. DGX = De Ge Ix. It applies to whole words and to all speech output, Open WebUI included.

head: Voice chat
title: Barge-in
text: Barge-in: while the assistant speaks, the microphone keeps listening. Talking for about a quarter of a second interrupts the answer, and what you said becomes the next question. This relies on the browser's echo cancellation; if the assistant interrupts itself on loud speakers, use headphones or untick "barge in" below the chat.

head: Voice chat
title: Read answers aloud (since V01.0.409)
text: Read answers aloud (since V01.0.409): if you do not want speech output, switch it off. For one device, the "Vorlesen" switch below the face (on a phone the speaker icon at the top right of the chat) is enough; it applies to this browser or the Android app only. For all devices of the profile: conversation settings → answer → "Read answers aloud". The Spark then answers as text only, does not call the speech output at all (saves the GPU) and plays no instant acknowledgement either; notes, messages and reminders come with a chime and text but are not read aloud. Speakers without a screen and CarPlay keep speaking, there is nothing to read there. "Read again" on an answer still works. The Spark-Begleiter does not read "Frag Spark" answers aloud either while "Read answers aloud" is off.

head: Voice chat
title: Your own voice
text: Your own voice: under Voices you can record a reference straight from the microphone (read the suggested text, about 10 seconds); the panel fills in the transcript with the speech recognition. Cloning needs a Base model (Settings → Speech output → model …-Base), then pick the new voice as the default voice. The default voice is a list that fits the chosen model: CustomVoice shows the built-in speakers, Base your own voices, with VoiceDesign it is locked (the voice comes from the speaking style); a saved name missing from the list stays as "(not in the list)". A German reference gives much steadier German than the built-in speakers, which are not native German speakers. Under Voices, one or all of your own voices can be exported as a ZIP (reference audio and transcript) and imported again on this or another Spark; on a name clash the import renames, replaces or skips.

head: Voice chat
title: Required tools and answer check (V01.0.117)
text: Required tools and answer check (V01.0.117): questions about appointments, mail, reminders, timers, weather, parcels, transit, lists, match results and news have to go through the matching tool (one table NEED_TOOLS in chat.py, also used by the quality test). While the model chooses the tool, the "tool choice" temperature (0.1) applies, the normal one afterwards. The answer check (Settings → Language model, on by default) lets no sentence through for such questions that names a time, date, score or amount that is in no tool result, the question or the conversation so far; instead the assistant says once "Genauere Angaben dazu habe ich nicht." If the model answers without looking anything up, the answer is dropped and the model is asked once more. Both show up in the tool log as "Antwort-Prüfung". General questions without a tool are not checked. Optional: the admin allows "think while choosing tools" (off); then it works for every profile, never for guests. Since V01.0.404 a round with thinking holds its text until the thinking is over: when the server does not hand the thinking over apart (reasoning_content) but as text up to a lone </think> (Qwen gets the opening <think> in the p

head: Voice chat
title: Required tools and answer check (V01.0.117)
text: rompt), everything before it is never shown, spoken or kept; a lone </think> is never shown (before, the answer came twice with </think> between). Since V01.0.455 no sentence of an answer comes twice: when the model writes the answer before a tool call (also one it only writes as text) and again after the result, the next round shows each sentence only once it is complete and leaves out sentences already said, in the chat and in the voice; Logs → Requests then show "Repetition left out" with the count.

head: Voice chat
title: Check deeds and stop error loops (V01.0.477)
text: Check deeds and stop error loops (V01.0.477): two protection rules, on by default like the answer check (Settings → Language model, chat.action_check, chat.loop_stop, reason in features.DEFAULT_ON), without a switch per profile (taten.py, fixed rules, no model). Check deeds: every tool that changes something has a kind (taten.KIND: geraet, erinnerung, termin, mail_entwurf, dokument, remarkable, nachricht, merken, aufgabe). Per answer the panel keeps which kind worked (the same failure words as Logs → Requests; "NOT saved yet" counts as a proposal, not as a deed). When a finished sentence claims a deed ("is on now", "I have entered it", "has been sent", "I'll remember", a bare "Done." while something that changes things was offered) and none of the kinds it names worked, it is neither shown nor spoken. At the end comes one fixed sentence: "That did not work: TV." (the tool ran and failed) or "I did not do that." (it did not run); nothing while a proposal is open. No second try. In doubt the sentence is said (it names several deeds and one of them worked). Stop error loops: when the same tool fails twice with the same details (or three times with any), it is not offered again for the

head: Voice chat
title: Check deeds and stop error loops (V01.0.477)
text: rest of the answer, the model hears why, a further call is not run. Visible in Logs → Requests ("Taten-Prüfung", "Schleife gestoppt"), in the journal (chat: action check: held back kind=… reason=…, chat: loop stop: tool=… fails=…) and on the Live page ("Taten-Prüfung": held back and stopped today, numbers only). The settings assistant's rule set will use the same interface taten.check(text, acts, offered) (a fixed "built-in" rule).

head: Voice chat
title: Three red questions in the quality test (V01.0.574)
text: Three red questions in the quality test (V01.0.574): (1) Announced deed: a sentence that only announces a tool call or a deed ("I'm calling the timer tool …", "I'll set a timer …", taten.announces) is neither shown nor spoken while no tool has worked in this answer. When a tool call follows, it is left out silently; when none follows, the panel says "I did not do that." at the end. Check deeds now also applies when no tool at all was offered (then every claimed deed is false). Journal: chat: action check: held back kind=ankuendigung …, chat: action check: announcement left out, a tool ran. (2) Remember only what there is to remember: a message that only asks (one sentence with a question mark, no "remember", nothing the person says about themselves like "I am …"; chat.just_asks) is not offered memory_save (chat.offer_memory, in the quality test as well), so "Do you know my brother's name?" never saves a made-up fact; journal chat: memory_save not offered - the message only asks. (3) Account balance: there is no bank tool, so every honest answer is right ("no access", "no tool", "check your banking app"). Since the fix after V01.0.597 the quality test checks no wording here, only fa

head: Voice chat
title: Three red questions in the quality test (V01.0.574)
text: cts: an amount in figures or words (quality.MONEY) or an unsuitable tool fails. The two cases without calendar and mail access still accept every "no access" answer (quality.NO_ACCESS).

head: Voice chat
title: Appointments only fresh from the calendar (V01.0.348)
text: Appointments only fresh from the calendar (V01.0.348): "Guten Morgen" on its own (also with "Spark", "wie geht's") counts as asking for the day: the switch files it under the calendar and the first round has to call daily_briefing (without the briefing: calendar_events). Before another request ("Guten Morgen, turn on the light") it does not. Every calendar result marks appointments that have already ended with "(already over)"; briefing and daily overview do not name them as coming up. Once an answer has read the calendar, the answer check takes times, dates and quoted appointment titles only from the question, the instructions and this answer's results, no longer from earlier answers in the conversation, so yesterday's appointments never come back as today's (tool log: "Termin aus früherer Antwort").

head: Voice chat
title: Learning from corrections (V01.0.118)
text: Learning from corrections (V01.0.118): admin switch Features → "Aus Korrekturen lernen", off; released for every profile, never guests or another voice. When a message right after an answer starts like a correction ("Nein, …", "Das stimmt nicht", "Du sollst …", at least three words), the model words a short sentence on the side (fixes.py) and the assistant ends with "Soll ich mir merken: …?". It is stored only after a plain yes from the same conversation within 15 minutes. Never proposed: sentences about code words, PINs, passwords, rules, security, confirmations, locks or alarms, world knowledge (scores, amounts) and links; after mail or outside text there is no proposal, and the earlier answer is then not sent along. The tool log shows a "Korrektur" entry; "Send the question to the admin as a test case" puts the corrected question into quality-cases.json (at most 30) and it runs with the quality test: all tools offered, each finds nothing, made-up figures count as a failure. The admin deletes them under Status → Checks → Quality test.

head: Voice chat
title: Memory check (V01.0.467)
text: Memory check (V01.0.467): admin switch Features → Memory check, off; released for every profile, never guests (gedaechtnis.py, plan gedaechtnis-pruefen/plan.md). Every entry keeps its evidence, also while the switch is off: where it came from (said remembered in a conversation, fix from a confirmed correction, auto learned from a quiet conversation, hand changed under Me, tidy from an accepted cleanup proposal), which conversation (own ones only, never to the model) and when it was last confirmed. Entries of older versions count as auto when they were learned, else as said. Fixed rules of the panel, no model, mark: R1 a date it names is more than a day past (never birthdays, "seit", "ab", "jeden"; "Still right" after the date keeps it), R2 "tomorrow", "next week" … older than 14 days or "currently", "right now" … older than 90 days, R3 learned automatically, never confirmed and older than "Learned counts as old after" (setting under Features, 1–60 months, default 6), R4 contradiction: two entries say the same thing with another value (fixed patterns "X is called", "lives in", "works at/as", "drives a", "is married to", "favourite … is", kept apart by whom it is about); the one said

head: Voice chat
title: Memory check (V01.0.467)
text: or confirmed last wins. Nothing is deleted. The model gets the entries in three blocks: sure, learned (with the month), "maybe outdated, never say it as a fact". Under Me → Memory there are marks (confirmed, learned, outdated?, contradiction), the filter "Outdated", a note card and, on a tap, where from (with "Open the conversation"), remembered, confirmed, the reason and "Still right" (POST /api/profile/memory/{id}/confirm, rate limit "memory"). Live: node "Memory" with counts per mark; Logs: area "Memory" (gedaechtnis: pruefung …, only when the numbers change); Logs → Requests: step "Memory (panel)" with numbers.

head: Voice chat
title: Versions and check-back (V01.0.467)
text: Versions and check-back (V01.0.467): with Memory check on, a confirmed correction about the same thing ("lives in …", "drives a …", "X is called …") becomes a new version of that entry instead of a second entry; ✎ Change keeps the old wording too. Up to 5 earlier versions show in the detail under Me → Memory with "Bring back" (POST /api/profile/memory/{id}/restore, login, profile binding, CSRF, 256 bytes, rate limit). Sub-switch Features → Memory check → "Check back in conversations" (chat.memory_ask, off; released for every profile): when an entry that may be out of date fits the question (a shared word, fixed rule), the panel adds "Quick check: is this still right: …?" after the answer. At most once per conversation, three times a day, the same entry once in 30 days; never with someone else's voice, after mail or web pages, during an emergency stop or while another question is open. The answer is open for 15 minutes (users/<id>/memory-ask.json): "yes" confirms, "forget it" deletes, "no" changes nothing, a correction goes through "Learn from corrections" and becomes a new version after a yes. Live shows open questions as a number, Logs → Requests the step "Memory check-back (panel

head: Voice chat
title: Versions and check-back (V01.0.467)
text: )", the journal gedaechtnis: nachfrage … and gedaechtnis: fassung … grund=….

head: Voice chat
title: Memory topics (V01.0.467)
text: Memory topics (V01.0.467): sub-switch Features → Memory check → "Memory topics" (chat.memory_topics, off; released for every profile). In the background (never while someone is talking) the language model in the home network sorts entries without a topic once into a fixed topic: person, home, on the move, work, health, right now, other; any other answer becomes "other", after a failure it tries again only after an hour. Me → Memory then shows the entries in groups; in the detail the person picks another topic (POST /api/profile/memory/{id}/topic), which the model never changes again. The topic is only for display, does not go to the model when answering and changes no rights. Live shows "N ohne Thema", the journal gedaechtnis: themen … gesetzt=N. The quality test has the cases "gedaechtnis-veraltet" (an outdated entry is never stated as a fact) and "gedaechtnis-bestaetigt" (a confirmed one is used).

head: Voice chat
title: Language model settings (V01.0.121)
text: Language model settings (V01.0.121): Under Settings → Language model → Advanced the admin sets the history length (4000–64000 characters, default 24000), web searches per answer (1–3, default 2), the time limit for an answer (60–600 s), top_p and presence_penalty (0 = the server's default) and own keywords that require a tool (one line per tool, e.g. web_search: elfmeter, aufstellung; whole words only, at most 20 per tool, the built-in words always stay). "Restore default" fills in the shipped system prompt, "Show the whole prompt" lists all parts in order and marks the fixed ones. With Features → "Own conversation style" (off) each profile can say under Me → Conversation → Answer, in at most 500 characters, how the assistant should talk to it; the text sits below the system prompt and above the fixed rules, never applies to guests or another voice and cannot be changed with a device key. Fixed: tool rules, handling of outside text, code word, locks and the values of background jobs (learning, briefing, mail sorting, room).

head: Voice chat
title: Roles by voice (V01.0.249)
text: Roles by voice (V01.0.249): With the admin switch Features → Own conversation style → Roles by voice (off) every profile adds up to 8 own roles under Me → Conversation → Answer, one per line like "Butler: polite, dry, with British understatement"; nothing needs to be switched on for it. "Sei jetzt der Butler", "Wechsle zur Rolle Erklärbär" or "Rolle Butler" switch, "Sei wieder normal" ends the role, "Welche Rollen hast du?" lists them. The panel recognizes these sentences with fixed rules only in the person's own latest message and only for a saved name ("Sei leise" stays a normal question); that answer has no tools, the model only says the result. The active role applies on all devices of the profile, sits in the prompt after the own conversation style and before the fixed tool rules, and changes only the tone, never the rules. Never guests or another voice; roles are changed only in the own browser, not with a device key, and the admin's defaults never hand out roles. Log line: "rolle: set - Butler".

head: Voice chat
title: Wikipedia straight away (V01.0.249)
text: Wikipedia straight away (V01.0.249): With the admin switch Features → Web search → Wikipedia straight away (off, works without a SearXNG address too) every profile the admin does not block gets in the assistant the tool wikipedia. For knowledge questions ("What is a quasar?", "Who was Ada Lovelace?") the panel fetches the intro of the matching article with one request to the MediaWiki API (at most 1,500 characters, answer at most 1 MB) instead of SearXNG and whole pages; the model reads far less and starts sooner. With no hit on de.wikipedia.org it asks en.wikipedia.org; the admin can enter an own address (then without a second try). Answers are kept in memory for 24 hours (at most 300). It reads only the person's own latest message, never outside text or model output, and writes one weiche: line per question to the journal (intent, the word that matched, number of tools, required tool, lock); the diagnosis filter "Chat" shows it. With the admin switch Features → "Gezielte Werkzeugwahl" (off, then for every profile, never guests) the model sees only the tools of a clear question's group (plus "remember"); a group with one tool (weather, web search, transit) makes the first round call exactly that one. The switch only takes away what the rights check before it allowed, never more. After an answer from the web, calendar, a document or a picture, a new request in the person's own words lifts the lock and the old answer is no longer sent along; if the request points at it ("Setz das auf die Liste", "Erinner mich daran", "Und …"), everything stays locked. Mail keeps the rule from V01.0.194. When s

title: Voice chat
text: The switch shown and set up (Features → Switch, plan plaene/weiche-sichtbar.md): a page of its own beside "Who may do what" shows the switch as a picture. "Try" sends a sentence through the same rules as a real question and shows its way in six boxes: question (points back or not), checks first (small talk, about the Spark, message to someone), group (with the word that matched, built in or own), tools (from the group, extra, always kept), locks (the protection rules with a lock) and result (read directly, required tool, instant sentence). No model, nothing stored. Below, the groups as a list with details: built-in words, own words as chips (chat.route_words), new "Not with" (chat.route_not: a word takes the group out again), extra tools (chat.route_extra, at most 6, only the switch's own tools and only when the question is offered them anyway) and narrowing per group (chat.route_off: the group is recognized but gets every allowed tool). All of it only takes away or stays within the rights; the protection rules (nothing switched or remembered after mail or outside text, emergency stop, at most 2 lookups) are no setting. Test sentences: the built-in ones (app/panel/intent_bench.py,
